answer: The sable holds work receipts rather than names, so the saffron of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ferrous of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
